title: Internal: Debit Card Rush Delivery Fee Change (Effective 10/01/2025)
content:
## Updated Fee

- Effective 10/01/2025, the RUSH delivery fee for debit card orders is $25 (delivery_fee: 25).
- STANDARD and EXPEDITED delivery fees are unchanged.
- Tell the customer about the fee before placing the order; it is deducted from the linked checking account.
